name: Monolith Story 3D
description: Low-poly story 3D format: one recurring monolith or object persists across every scene while the backdrop changes color per scene (keyed to the palette roles), pixel-font signs stand in the world, and the camera pushes in, orbits and drifts. A format, not a scene: the agent designs the monolith, the signs and each scene's surroundings from scratch for each video. No emoji.
prompt_hint: 6-10 scenes (3-5 s). Each: title.kicker + title.main, visual.type "scene3d" with a `custom` hero object (the same monolith in every scene: copy its parts), a `world` whose `backdrop` is a different palette token each scene (accent, accent2, accent3, muted) and a few `sign` parts for pixel-font labels. Use camera push / orbit / handheld and `shots`. No emoji.
